title: Administrative Operations Specialist—GA
description:
Key Responsibilities

1.Asset Management

Manage company assets, including office equipment and warehouse facilities, conduct regular inventory checks, and update asset records to ensure accuracy and completeness.

2.Procurement Management

Oversee daily procurement activities, maintain strong relationships with suppliers, and ensure timely purchasing of materials to support company operations.

3. Contract Management

Organize and archive contracts, ensuring accuracy and completeness, and provide necessary contract support to effectively manage company procurement and assets.

4.Budget Tracking & Analysis

Monitor and analyze budget execution, assist in preparing and adjusting budget reports, ensuring the efficient allocation and use of financial resources.

5.HR & Administrative Support

Provide basic HR administrative support, assist in organizing employee activities and corporate culture development, fostering a positive work environment and enhancing employee satisfaction.

Requirements

1. Education

Associate’s degree or above, with at least 2 years of relevant work experience; familiarity with asset management, procurement processes, and contract management is preferred.

2. Cultural Awareness

Good understanding of U.S. local culture and holidays, with multicultural experience preferred.

3. Skills

Strong communication skills and teamwork spirit, capable of working efficiently under pressure. Proficient in office software (e.g., Word, Excel, PPT) and relevant management tools.

4. Language

Proficient in English listening, speaking, reading, and writing, with the ability to communicate and negotiate with local suppliers.

5. Work Authorization

Legally authorized to work in the United States.

title: Inventory Control & Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
Key Responsibilities:

1. Inventory Control

① Conduct daily cycle counts and key inventory audits to maintain inventory accuracy.

② Identify and analyze inventory discrepancies, investigate root causes, and implement corrective actions.

③ Monitor inventory movement data to ensure warehouse management system (WMS) records match physical stock levels.

④ Assist in resolving inventory-related issues, such as lost, damaged, expired, or misplaced items.

2. Quality Assurance

① Conduct quality inspections to ensure all items meet company and customer quality standards.

② Oversee the handling of returned and damaged goods, analyze quality issues, and provide improvement recommendations.

③ Ensure proper storage conditions in the warehouse to maintain quality and safety standards.

3. Operations Optimization

① Participate in warehouse process optimization to enhance inventory management efficiency and reduce errors.

② Support ICQA Supervisor in analyzing data and implementing inventory control strategies.

③ Utilize data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI) to generate inventory and quality reports for management review.

4. Safety & Compliance

① Ensure all inventory control procedures comply with company safety policies and OSHA regulations.

② Participate in ICQA-related training sessions and knowledge sharing to improve team capabilities.

Qualifications:

1. Education: Associate’s degree or higher in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

2.Work Experience: 1+ years of experience in warehouse inventory management or quality control, with a solid understanding of logistics and warehouse operations.

3.Experience in team management with the ability to lead and motivate employees to enhance performance.

4.Proficient in WMS (Warehouse Management System).

5.Strong analytical skills with the ability to make data-driven optimization decisions.

6.Excellent communication skills to coordinate outbound processes across departments.

7.Language Requirement: English proficiency as a working language is required; fluency in the local language and Chinese is preferred.

8. Others: Legally authorized to work in the United States.

title: warehouse team leader
description:
Job Description ：

1. Receive and verify incoming goods, and enter data into the inventory management system to ensure the accuracy of inventory information.

2. Accurately pick, pack, and prepare orders for shipment according to customer requirements, ensuring that goods meet outbound standards.

3. Organize warehouse items, maintain inventory levels, and conduct regular inventory checks to ensure the accuracy of inventory data.

4. Prepare and label shipments, process orders, and coordinate with transportation companies to arrange on-time delivery.

5. Operate forklifts or other warehouse equipment, adhere to safe operating procedures, keep the warehouse clean, and report any safety hazards or equipment malfunctions.

Job Requirements：

1. Prior experience in warehouse or similar work environments is preferred.

2. Ability to operate warehouse equipment (e.g., forklifts, pallet trucks) is preferred.

3. Basic computer skills and ability to use inventory management and shipping software.

4. Strong attention to detail to ensure order accuracy and inventory tracking.

5. Sufficient physical strength to lift heavy objects (up to 50 lbs) and stand for extended periods.

6. Legally able to work and pay taxes in the United States.
